description:
Bureau of Espionage, Chief of Special Operations Division 2
Founder of the new squad he has dubbed the Secret Anti-Mononoke Mobile Strike Force, code named "Black Torch", Shiba is a complicated, rebellious soul. While his independent, anarchist streak has turned him into somewhat of an outsider with his peers and a pariah with his superiors, he`s also an undeniably strong leader who has the complete trust of his subordinates.
Source: Official page
name: Shiba Ryousuke
